info.title: Q-Cash API Docs
info.description: Q-Cash Early Revenue Access (ERA) API for MSMEs in Kenya. Manages businesses, payment accounts, raw transactions, ERA assessments, advance offers, disbursements and hybrid repayments. All monetary amounts are expressed as integer minor currency units (KES cents) and percentage rates as integer basis points.

post.description:
Called by Safaricom before accepting a paybill payment. Unknown collection
account numbers are rejected so payments cannot be attributed incorrectly.

Records the raw callback and creates an inflow transaction for the business
matching the collection account number. Always acknowledges the callback so
Safaricom does not retry a payment that we have already accepted.

Logs the raw callback, matches it to the originating business, records the
transaction and notifies the owner. Always acknowledges the callback.
